title: The Lost Shoe
text: Today was the big soccer game. {{name}} woke up early and felt excited. {{name}} put on one soccer shoe. But the other shoe was lost! {{name}} looked under the bed. The shoe was not there. {{name}} looked behind the door. It was not there either. {{name}} looked everywhere in the bedroom. Where could the shoe be? "Where is my shoe?" {{name}} said. Mom came to help look. They looked in the bag and the box. Then {{name}} heard a soft noise. The little dog ran into the room. The dog had the shoe in its mouth! "There it is!" {{name}} laughed. The dog liked to hide things. {{name}} gave the dog a gentle hug. Then {{name}} put on the shoe fast. {{name}} ran to the soccer field. The game was about to start. {{name}} played well and had fun. {{name}}'s team won the game. Everyone clapped for the team. {{name}} thanked Mom and the funny dog. It was a wonderful day for {{name}}.
summary: 比赛日清晨主角找不到一只足球鞋,翻遍床下门后和包里都没有,最后发现是小狗把鞋藏起来叼在嘴里,主角穿好鞋赶到球场,球队赢得比赛。
